title: Corpus: regenerate capability_prefix_delegation + capability_both vectors with canonical ceil prefixes
description: Found during zeaj fix. test/vectors/capability_announcements.json vectors capability_prefix_delegation (prefix_len 64, 16-byte prefix) and capability_both (prefix_len 48, 16-byte prefix) violate the spec 8.12 canonical form (prefix is ceil(prefix_len/8) bytes: 8 and 6 respectively). Both Python (capability_announcements.py __post_init__ ceil check) and Rust (from_cose_sign1, zeaj) now reject them at decode. The Rust corpus test skips them as decode-rejects; other consumers may still treat them as happy-path. Regenerate via test/vectors/generate_capability_announcements.py with canonical prefixes (8/6 bytes) — re-signing changes payload_cbor, cose_sign1, and sig_structure_hash for those two vectors; check all consumers (C, Python orphan-consumer tests) after regenerating.
close_reason: Corpus regenerated with canonical ceil prefixes: capability_prefix_delegation now prefix_len=64 with 8-byte fd00000000000000 (was 16B), capability_both now prefix_len=48 with 6-byte fd0000000000 (was 16B) — spec 8.12 ceil(prefix_len/8) canonical form. Signatures/sig_structure_hash/payload_cbor/cose_sign1 re-signed by the independent reference_schnorr48 generator (no self-oracle). Consumer updates: Python test_orphan_vector_consumers _DECODE_REJECT entries removed (both now decode; sig-forgery detection still pinned independently at :209-216 before decode); Rust corpus skip-gate + vector_prefix_is_canonical helper from the previous commit removed (now-dead code) so all 9 vectors take the full decode-verify-encode path; crafted-envelope noncanonical_prefix_is_rejected still pins the old 16B/64 shape -> Malformed. Verified: Python CapabilityPayload.from_cbor accepts all regenerated payloads; orphan consumer 10/10; Rust gateway 261/261. 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS (signatures recomputed valid, truncations exact, no other vector changed), security PASS (trust root stable, no fail-closed coverage weakened — Python length-mismatch + reserved-bits pins retained, Rust skip-gate removal strictly strengthens), edge-cases PASS (/48 and /64 are byte-aligned so trivially canonical; gateway into_entry zero-pads short prefixes correctly; spec/docstring 'prefix_len/8' wording coincides for these lengths).
